newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Monday that around 1,375 head were exported into the United States at three crossing points Friday.
Through Nogales, Ariz., around 1,000 head were sold at mostly steady prices for steer calves.
"Trade moderate, demand good. Bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lb," the USDA said. Prices for 300-400 lb feeder steers were between 75-85 cents a lb.
Through Hidalgo, Texas, around 75 head were sold, but not enough to establish trend or quote prices.
Through Eagle Pass, Texas, around 300 head crossed, although again not enough to establish trend prices.
((--Chris Aspin, Mexico City newsroom (525) 7289530. E-mail at chris.aspin@reuters.com))
